title: mzPeak imaging discovery metadata
description: Governs mzpeak_index.json.metadata.imaging. The per-pixel coordinate columns (IMS:1000050/51/52) and ms_run.parameters remain the authoritative source for spatial/geometry data; this block is discovery-only and MAY be incomplete at write time (D-03 relaxes spec v0.3 §8 'required pixel_count' — real-world imzML frequently omits grid counts). Only is_imaging and coordinate_base are guaranteed.

pixel_count.description: OPTIONAL — relaxes spec v0.3 §8 'required'. Absent when the imzML omits grid counts (IMS:1000042/43); the Phase 5 verifier MAY derive it from max observed coordinates. The coordinate columns remain authoritative regardless.

z.description: OPTIONAL grid depth (z-stack); absent for 2D imaging.

pixel_count_source.description: OPTIONAL — provenance of pixel_count: "declared" (from imzML IMS:1000042/43) or "observed_max" (derived from max observed coordinates).

mz_range.description: OPTIONAL MS1-only observed m/z bounds across the run.

images.description: OPTIONAL per-image descriptive metadata for optical images stored as ZIP members.

archive_path.description: Path of the image within the mzPeak ZIP, e.g. images/image_0000.tiff.

source_name.description: Original filename of the imported image.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the stored image.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the stored image bytes.

size_bytes.description: Size of the stored image in bytes.

affine.description: Full-extent display-hint affine mapping 0-based image pixels to 1-based MS pixels.

pixel_size_um.description: OPTIONAL physical pixel size in µm (IMS:1000046/47).

max_dimension_um.description: OPTIONAL max image dimension in µm (IMS:1000044/45).

absolute_offset_um.description: OPTIONAL absolute position offset in µm (IMS:1000053/54).

scan_type.description: IMS CURIE, e.g. IMS:1000480 horizontal line scan

line_scan_direction.description: IMS CURIE, e.g. IMS:1000491 linescan left-right

coordinate_base.description: Fixed at 1 in v1 — top-left origin, 1-based, no axis flip (spec v0.3 §5.1).
